result.brief: 提出回溯式世界建模，通过估计状态转移的动作归因分布构建自洽奖励，为智能体提供密集反馈，提升策略鲁棒性与泛化。
result.reason: Introduces retrospective world modeling for VLM agents, estimating action attribution from state transitions and using self-consistency reward for physically grounded planning—directly enabling world-model-based planning.
